metaDescription.id: Harianja & Putra adalah firma hukum independen di Jakarta dan Denpasar yang menangani transaksi, kontrak, sengketa, dan kepatuhan.
metaDescription.en: Harianja & Putra is an independent law firm in Jakarta and Denpasar handling transactions, contracts, disputes, and compliance.

heading.id: Advokat korporasi dan sengketa untuk bisnis di Indonesia.
heading.en: Corporate and dispute lawyers for business in Indonesia.

subheading.id: Kami menangani transaksi, kontrak, sengketa, dan kepatuhan untuk perusahaan, investor, pemilik usaha, dan klien perorangan. Setiap nasihat kami timbang terhadap dampaknya bagi bisnis Anda.
subheading.en: We handle transactions, contracts, disputes, and compliance for companies, investors, business owners, and private clients. Every piece of advice we give is weighed against its effect on your business.

children.text: Contoh ini menunjukkan tampilan artikel di situs: paragraf pembuka, judul bagian, teks isi, daftar, dan kutipan.
Teks isi
Teks isi berukuran 18px dengan tinggi baris 1,7. Panjang baris dijaga sekitar 70 karakter supaya teks hukum yang panjang tetap nyaman dibaca.
Daftar dan klausul
Daftar memakai garis tipis di antara butir.
Nomor klausul memakai angka tabular supaya sejajar.
Tautan diberi garis bawah dan berubah warna saat disorot.
Kutipan
Kutipan muncul satu kali per artikel, untuk kalimat yang perlu diingat pembaca.
This sample shows how an article reads on the site: lead paragraph, headings, body text, a list, and a pull quote.
Body text
Body text is set at 18px with a 1.7 line height. Lines stay near 70 characters, which keeps long legal text easy to read.
Lists and clauses
Lists use a thin rule between items.
Clause numbers use tabular figures so they line up.
Links are underlined and turn brass on hover.
Pull quote
A pull quote appears once per article, for the sentence a reader should remember.
